name: Food Price Pressure (exploratory)
version: label-v2.0 (revised 2026-10-15; supersedes the withdrawn FSI anchor design)
framing: Food Price Pressure (exploratory) measures provincial food price pressure, not food insecurity. HIGH means the province's food inflation (PSA, year on year) was above 4 percent, the ceiling of the BSP inflation target, which is a headline-inflation target and not a food-specific one. The 4 percent rule is a tool-adopted default; it is not adviser-endorsed and not validated. High food inflation does not prove hunger, and low food inflation does not prove adequate food.

units.F: percent, year-on-year change of the provincial food CPI (01.1 FOOD)
units.H: percent of families (SWS self-rated involuntary hunger, Balance Luzon)

F.what: PSA provincial food CPI (01.1 FOOD) year-on-year rate as PUBLISHED by PSA (one decimal, monthly); quarter value = mean of the quarter's three published monthly rates
F.table: PSA OpenStat 0012M4ACP23 (2026) / the same published series for 2021-2025
F.release_timing: monthly CPI is released by PSA in the first week of the following month; the quarter value of quarter q is treated as available only at origins O(t) with t >= q + 1 (conservative: all three months published before the origin)

H.what: SWS Balance Luzon hunger, approved series only (definition_A = True); quarter value = mean of the quarter's approved rounds
H.availability: a quarter's H is usable only after ALL its approved rounds were posted (posted date in the file)

D.what: F minus the five-province mean of F (informational only; not part of any target)

label_A.name: Food Price Pressure HIGH
label_A.rule: HIGH if F_pq > 4.0, else NOT HIGH; missing F -> no label
label_A.threshold_source: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas inflation-targeting framework: the inflation target of 3.0 percent +/- 1.0 percentage point set by the Development Budget Coordination Committee; 4.0 percent is its ceiling. It is a HEADLINE CPI target, not a food-specific one. (Cited from the BSP framework; the page was not re-fetched in this run.)
label_A.status: tool-adopted default; not adviser-endorsed; not validated; not tuned or selected from any result

target_C.name: Regional SWS hunger H (continuous)
target_C.value: H_q (one value shared by all five provinces)

provincial_ranking.rule: rank provinces within a quarter by F (descending: rank 1 = highest food inflation); ties share the average rank and carry a tied flag
provincial_ranking.vulnerability_weights: not part of any label; used only by the existing LGU ranking (PSA 2021 SAE, POPCEN 2024)

no_leakage: every label value uses only data of its own quarter; no reference window, no anchor fitted to data, no constant other than 4.0
evaluation_dependence: the five provinces share H (target C is regional) but differ in F; scoring is date-level (see scoring_v2_spec.json)
